description: This file defines the Customer class within the Opencart system, handling customer data, login, logout, and related operations.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents a customer in the Opencart system, managing customer data, authentication, and session state.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Customer object, loading customer data if session indicates a logged-in customer.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a customer using email and password, updating session and customer info on success.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the current customer, clearing session and customer data.

methods.name: isLogged
methods.description: Checks if a customer is currently logged in.

methods.name: getNewsletter
methods.description: Returns whether the customer is subscribed to newsletter.

methods.name: isSafe
methods.description: Indicates if the customer is marked as safe.

methods.name: isCommenter
methods.description: Indicates if the customer has commenter privileges.

methods.name: getAddressId
methods.description: Retrieves the default address ID for the customer.

methods.name: getBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the customer's total balance.

methods.name: getRewardPoints
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total reward points for the customer.
